create.name: Noirin Sheahan
create.bio:
Noirin Sheahan is an Irish vipassana teacher in the Mahasi tradition who lives at Satipanya, a small Buddhist retreat centre in the Shropshire hills near Minsterley, where she is one of two spiritual directors. Born in Dublin, she worked there as a physicist and engineer. She has practised under Bhante Bodhidhamma since the 1980s, took part in the first Dharma study course at Gaia House, and after a year of long retreats in England and the United States was recognised by him as a Dhamma teacher. In 2011 she spent a period ordained as a nun in the Burmese tradition, and since settling at Satipanya in 2020 she has kept lay vows.

She leads long silent retreats at Satipanya built on alternating sitting and walking practice and the careful noting of experience, and also teaches at Gaia House and at centres in Ireland. Her online study courses take one theme, such as the hindrances or the noble truths, over several weeks, with notes and exercises for everyday life; those notes grew into her 2025 book Sharing the Path. Her essays and recordings are free on the Satipanya site.

courses.title: Ongoing Mahasi Retreat with Noirin Sheahan (spring)
courses.description: A residential silent retreat at Satipanya in the Mahasi style of vipassana, with alternating periods of sitting and walking meditation through the day. Applications open on 18 January 2027, and like all Satipanya courses it is offered on a donation basis.
courses.price: Donation (dana); the centre states its costs at about £45 GBP per person per night

courses.title: Ongoing Mahasi Retreat with Noirin Sheahan (summer)
courses.description: A four-week residential Mahasi retreat she leads at Satipanya in the summer, following the centre's daily timetable of walking and sitting practice in silence. Applications open on 18 January 2027 and payment is by donation.
courses.price: Donation (dana); the centre states its costs at about £45 GBP per person per night

free_resources.title: Vipassana Instructions
free_resources.description: An audio recording of her basic guidance for Mahasi-style insight practice. It covers how to sit, how to walk and how to note what arises.

free_resources.title: Sharing the Path
free_resources.description: A free PDF of her 2025 book, drawn from years of her online daily-life courses and the reflections students shared on them. Each part takes a theme of the Dhamma and shows how to work with it in ordinary situations.

free_resources.title: Introduction to the Mahasi Meditation Practice
free_resources.description: Her opening retreat talk on the Mahasi method, written by her and read aloud by a friend, Finola O'Siochru. It explains the purpose of noting and how the retreat days are structured.
